item.title: Senate Democrats ramp up pressure campaign for public hearings on war with Iran
item.summary: Congressional Democrats are demanding transparency in the form of public hearings from Trump administration officials on the timeline and objectives of the war in Iran.

item.title: Photos from Iran and across the Middle East as the war enters Week 2
item.summary: More than a week of the U.S. and Israel's war against Iran has dragged in global powers, upended the world's energy and transport sectors, and brought chaos to usually peaceful areas of the region.

item.title: Immigration detention on track for deadliest fiscal year since 2004
item.summary: Twenty-three people have died since October in ICE custody, as advocates warn about overcrowding and health care access.

item.title: 'American Classic' is a hidden gem that gets even better as it goes
item.summary: In this charming TV series, Kevin Kline plays a Shakespearean actor who retreats to his small hometown after a crisis, and gets engaged in an effort to save the local theater.

item.title: Americans are split on wanting the National Guard to monitor voting, a new poll finds
item.summary: Nearly half of Americans support the National Guard monitoring November's elections, potentially signaling an openness to the sort of nationalizing of elections that President Trump says he wants.

item.title: Federal oversight protects student borrowers. Some of it has stopped, watchdog says
item.summary: Without this Education Department oversight, borrowers could "be placed in the wrong loan repayment status, billed for incorrect amounts" and more, the U.S. Government Accountability Office says.

item.title: The Trump DOJ is giving guns back to felons, including one alleged fake elector
item.summary: The Department of Justice is quietly restarting a decades-dormant program to restore gun rights to felons. One of them was an alleged fake elector in 2020.

item.title: Wheelchair curler Steve Emt's path from drunk driver to three-time Paralympian
item.summary: Steve Emt and Laura Dwyer represent the U.S. in the Paralympics' new mixed doubles wheelchair curling event. They could bring home Team USA's first wheelchair curling medal ever.

item.title: Bam! Heat's Adebayo scores 83 points, 2nd only to Wilt Chamberlain in NBA history
item.summary: Bam Adebayo had a night for all time on Tuesday, with a point total second to only Wilt Chamberlain in the NBA record books.

item.title: Prosecutor says Rihanna, family were home when woman charged with attempted murder fired
item.summary: Rihanna, her partner A$AP Rocky, their three children and her mother were all at home when a woman now charged with attempted murder is alleged to have fired at the property, a prosecutor said.
